name: Buckshot Bourbon
tagline: Dust, steel strings, and a second chance at midnight.
description: Buckshot Bourbon is a Long Island country-rock band built around four lifelong friends, combining Nashville songwriting, Southern-rock muscle, and the unmistakable attitude of their New York roots.
biography: Buckshot Bourbon began with Tucker 'Tuck' Kennedy and David 'Fireball' Daniels, childhood friends who grew up three houses apart in Smithtown, New York. Colt 'Buckshot' McCrae joined them during middle school, bringing equal parts musical curiosity and unpredictable energy. The final piece arrived when David discovered Jackson 'Crash' Reilly, a younger football teammate whose unconscious drumming turned out to be the missing ingredient. After years of garage rehearsals, Long Island bars, and playing every show as though it were an arena, the four friends built a devoted following around their blend of country storytelling, Southern-rock grit, and hard-rock energy. Quantum Frequency Records signed Buckshot Bourbon after seeing the band's ability to turn an ordinary barroom into a room full of believers. The band's story is deeply intertwined with another QFR artist: Tucker's younger brother, Sawyer Kennedy, who later established himself as a solo Nashville country artist on the label. The Kennedy brothers give QFR one of its most personal artist connections.

members.name: Tucker Kennedy
members.role: Lead Vocals / Acoustic Guitar / Electric Guitar / Harmonica / Mandolin
members.bio: The heart and frontman of Buckshot Bourbon. Tuck brings a warm, charismatic presence to the stage and writes with the confidence of someone who knows exactly where he came from. His younger brother, Sawyer Kennedy, is also signed to QFR as a solo country artist.
members.style: Cowboy hat, clean-cut appearance, short hair, five-o'clock shadow, long-sleeve shirts, blue or black jeans, aviator sunglasses occasionally.

members.name: David Daniels
members.role: Backup Vocals / Electric Guitar / Lead Guitar / Bass Guitar / Banjo / Mandolin
members.bio: The band's firepower. David brings Nashville experience, hard-rock instincts, and an intensity that turns even a simple country progression into something capable of shaking a room.
members.style: Short pompadour-style hair, clean-cut appearance, medium beard and curled mustache, long-sleeve button-down shirt, leather vest, aviator sunglasses.

members.name: Colt McCrae
members.role: Bass Guitar / Banjo / Mandolin / Harmonica / Percussion
members.bio: The band's walking party. Colt is impossible to miss onstage, combining musical enthusiasm with his trademark American-flag bandana, cape, handlebar mustache, and larger-than-life personality.
members.style: American flag bandana, American flag cape, dramatic handlebar mustache, short textured hair, black shirt, blue jeans, decorated cowboy boots.

members.name: Jackson Reilly
members.bio: The silent engine of Buckshot Bourbon. Jackson is disciplined, focused, and almost unnervingly consistent behind the kit. The band jokes that while everyone else brings the party, Crash makes sure the party stays on time.
members.style: Short slicked-back hair, clean-shaven, black T-shirt, dark blue jeans, signature aviator sunglasses, occasional backwards snapback.

name: Sawyer Kennedy
tagline: Nashville steel with a late-night conscience.
description: Sawyer Kennedy is a Nashville country singer-songwriter known for emotionally direct storytelling, polished modern production, and songs that feel equally at home on a back porch or a sold-out arena.
biography: Sawyer Kennedy grew up on Long Island, New York, as the younger brother of Buckshot Bourbon frontman Tucker 'Tuck' Kennedy. While his brother found his voice in a band, Sawyer developed a quieter obsession with songwriting. He eventually moved to Nashville with a notebook, a borrowed guitar, and a determination to build a career on songs rather than shortcuts. After years of writer's rounds and independent recording sessions, Sawyer caught Quantum Frequency Records' attention with a collection of demos that balanced modern country hooks with unusually personal storytelling. QFR signed him as a solo artist, giving the Kennedy family a unique place within the label's growing universe.

members.name: Sawyer Kennedy
members.bio: A modern Nashville storyteller who writes from observation, memory, and experience. Sawyer is the younger brother of Buckshot Bourbon frontman Tucker Kennedy.

name: Fractal Hearts
tagline: Long-form rock for people who still look up.
description: Fractal Hearts create expansive progressive and space rock built from soaring guitars, layered synths, shifting rhythms, and songs that feel designed to be experienced rather than simply heard.
biography: Fractal Hearts formed in Philadelphia when five musicians discovered they shared an obsession with records that demanded headphones and uninterrupted attention. Their music moves between progressive-rock precision, space-rock atmosphere, and emotionally direct alternative-rock songwriting. The band became known for treating each album as a connected universe, allowing musical themes and melodies to reappear in unexpected places. Quantum Frequency Records signed Fractal Hearts because the band's ambition matched the label's belief that music does not need to fit a predetermined format.

members.name: Liam Mercer
members.bio: The atmospheric architect of Fractal Hearts, Liam builds the band's emotional center through layered keyboards and restrained vocal melodies.

members.name: Ben Holloway
members.bio: A texture-driven guitarist who specializes in turning simple motifs into enormous walls of sound.

members.name: David Mercer
members.bio: The band's primary frontman and principal songwriter, David combines progressive ambition with an instinct for memorable vocal hooks.

members.name: Chris Dalton
members.bio: A precise and dynamic drummer who moves effortlessly between intricate progressive passages and massive rock grooves.

members.name: Mark Ellison
members.bio: The foundation beneath the band's expansive sound. Mark approaches bass as both rhythm section and melodic instrument.

name: Grassroots Rebellion
description: Grassroots Rebellion combine punk urgency, pop-punk hooks, and alternative-rock songwriting with the attitude of a band that has never been interested in asking permission.
biography: Grassroots Rebellion grew out of Brooklyn basement shows, independent venues, and late-night rehearsal sessions where four friends learned that the best songs did not require permission from anyone. Their music is fast, melodic, sarcastic when necessary, and surprisingly vulnerable when the volume drops. Quantum Frequency Records connected with the band because their independent spirit mirrored the label's own philosophy: build something real first, then let the world catch up.

members.name: Dylan Reed
members.bio: The younger Reed brother and primary voice of Grassroots Rebellion. Dylan writes with equal parts urgency, humor, and frustration.

members.name: Brian Reed
members.bio: Dylan's older brother and the band's low-end anchor. Brian brings a steady presence that keeps the band's chaos controlled.

members.name: Travis Hamilton
members.bio: A relentless drummer whose playing gives the band's short songs their sense of forward motion.

members.name: Miles Harlan
members.bio: The band's second voice and rhythm guitarist, Miles provides the harmonies, counterpoints, and occasional chaos that make the choruses hit harder.

name: Warpnotix
description: Warpnotix is a genre-bending electronic project combining house production, festival-scale energy, pop-rock instrumentation, and cinematic sound design.
biography: Warpnotix is the project of Finn Thomas, a producer who spent years moving between club production, rock sessions, and electronic composition before deciding that none of the boundaries made much sense. His productions combine four-on-the-floor house rhythms with massive melodic drops, live guitar textures, and the emotional dynamics of arena rock. QFR signed Warpnotix because the project represents exactly what the label believes technology can do when it is used as a creative instrument rather than a substitute for creativity.

members.name: Finn Thomas
members.bio: Finn Thomas is the producer, DJ, songwriter, and creative director behind Warpnotix. His productions are designed to move between headphones, clubs, festivals, and rock stages without losing their identity.

name: Sound Shamans
description: Sound Shamans create atmospheric alternative rock built around layered guitars, hypnotic rhythms, expansive keyboards, and emotionally direct songwriting.
biography: Sound Shamans formed after years of playing different corners of the New York and New Jersey music scene. Their music combines intimate verses with expansive choruses, drawing from alternative rock, indie music, and the communal energy of live performance. QFR signed the band because their songs demonstrate the label's belief that commercial accessibility and artistic individuality do not have to be opposites.

members.name: Sam Sterling
members.bio: The band's primary vocalist and keyboardist. Sam writes melodies that begin quietly and grow into emotionally expansive choruses.

members.name: Ben Childs
members.bio: Ben provides the rhythmic architecture beneath the band's atmospheric sound.

members.name: Leo Philips
members.bio: A melodic lead guitarist known for using texture and space as much as traditional solos.

members.name: Max Wright
members.bio: Max expands the band's palette with atmospheric keyboards, synthesizers, and subtle electronic textures.

members.name: David Press
members.bio: David gives Sound Shamans their deep, patient foundation and prefers grooves that leave room for everything above them.

members.name: Ryan Lane
members.bio: Ryan combines disciplined pocket playing with dramatic dynamic shifts that help the band's songs breathe.

name: Immovable Giants
description: Immovable Giants build emotionally massive alternative rock from patient songwriting, layered guitars, organic instrumentation, and choruses designed to stay with you.
biography: Immovable Giants spent years developing their sound in Philadelphia before Quantum Frequency Records came calling. Their songs are patient rather than rushed, often beginning with a single guitar or piano before gradually expanding into enormous arrangements. Their latest album, 'The Signals We Leave Behind,' became a defining moment for the band, exploring memory, relationships, identity, and the traces people leave behind. QFR considers the group one of the label's core album-oriented acts.

members.name: Matthew Stone
members.bio: The primary songwriter and voice of Immovable Giants. Matthew's understated delivery gives the band's biggest moments their emotional weight.

members.name: Theo Brant
members.bio: Theo builds the band's expansive guitar arrangements and specializes in creating melodic lines that feel larger than the room.

members.name: Nolan Blake
members.bio: Nolan combines melodic bass work with harmony vocals that quietly become essential to the band's sound.

members.name: Cameron Ruiz
members.bio: A dynamics-first drummer who knows when to hold back and when to turn a song into a wall of sound.

name: The Jones Beach Boys
tagline: Reverb, salt, and a perfect chorus.
description: The Jones Beach Boys combine classic surf-rock guitar, stacked vocal harmonies, 1960s songwriting, and modern production into a sound that feels nostalgic without becoming a tribute act.
biography: The Jones Beach Boys started as a group of Long Island friends obsessed with old records, beach culture, and the deceptively difficult art of writing a perfect three-minute song. Their name began as an inside joke before becoming the identity of a band that quickly developed its own sound. They borrow the optimism, harmonies, and guitar language of the 1960s while writing completely original songs about modern life, summer nights, relationships, and growing older. QFR signed them because the band proves nostalgia can be a starting point rather than a destination.

members.name: Nick Ellery
members.bio: Nick's shimmering guitar lines provide the band's signature surf-rock identity.

members.name: Sam Prieto
members.bio: Sam leads the band's vocal arrangements and brings the optimistic center to their songwriting.

members.name: Dewey Hart
members.bio: Dewey combines melodic bass playing with the band's carefully constructed vocal harmonies.

members.name: Kit Ambrose
members.bio: Kit keeps the band's music moving with a relaxed pocket influenced by both surf rock and classic pop.

name: The Cosmic Run
tagline: Campfire songs for the upper atmosphere.
description: The Cosmic Run blend acoustic songwriting, alternative-rock dynamics, folk harmonies, and expansive electric textures into music that feels both grounded and weightless.
biography: The Cosmic Run formed around a group of friends who spent as much time hiking, driving, and writing as they did rehearsing. Their songs often begin with acoustic instruments and intimate lyrics before expanding into atmospheric rock arrangements. The band's name reflects their central philosophy: stay connected to the ground while always looking toward something larger. QFR signed The Cosmic Run as a bridge between the label's country, indie, rock, and experimental worlds.

members.name: June Calder
members.bio: June writes the band's most intimate songs and anchors the group with an unmistakably human vocal delivery.

members.name: Eli Navarro
members.bio: Eli creates the band's electric landscapes, moving effortlessly between understated textures and expansive leads.

members.name: Posey Lin
members.bio: Posey provides the melodic low end and much of the band's distinctive harmony work.

members.name: Hart Benson
members.bio: Hart brings organic percussion and dynamic restraint to the band's atmospheric arrangements.

name: Moonflower Radio
tagline: Tune in. Drift. Come back changed.
description: Moonflower Radio create hazy, psychedelic alternative rock where dreamy textures, hypnotic rhythms, and modern songwriting collide.
biography: Moonflower Radio grew out of the late-night music culture surrounding Asbury Park and the Jersey Shore. Their music has the atmosphere of an old radio signal drifting through a modern city: psychedelic guitars, warm synthesizers, loose grooves, and lyrics that explore memory and consciousness. QFR signed the band because their music occupies an unusual emotional space within the roster — relaxed enough for late nights but powerful enough to fill a room.

members.name: Lark Emerson
members.bio: Lark's understated vocal style and atmospheric guitar work form the center of Moonflower Radio.

members.name: Suki Arden
members.bio: Suki adds vintage keyboard textures, synthesizers, and harmony vocals to the band's psychedelic palette.

members.name: Paulie Trent
members.bio: Paulie's restrained, hypnotic bass lines give the band's songs their late-night pulse.

members.name: Dove Kim
members.bio: Dove blends motorik rhythms, classic rock grooves, and loose improvisation behind the kit.

name: Find/Replace
description: Find/Replace collide industrial electronics, nu-metal guitar weight, alternative-rock songwriting, and the anxiety of living inside systems that never seem to shut down.
biography: Find/Replace formed in a converted industrial warehouse in Newark, where the sounds of machinery became an accidental part of the band's identity. Their music explores technology, systems, surveillance, identity, work, and the collision between human emotion and increasingly automated lives. QFR signed the group because they bring a distinctly modern perspective to heavy music without relying on nostalgia.

members.name: Hex Calder
members.bio: Hex combines aggressive vocals with electronic programming and lyrical themes centered on modern systems and human identity.

members.name: Vex Moreau
members.bio: Vex builds the band's enormous guitar sound and treats feedback, noise, and texture as musical instruments.

members.name: Null Reyes
members.bio: Null bridges the band's electronic and organic sides with sub-heavy bass and dark synthesizer textures.

members.name: Tick Abram
members.bio: Tick combines live drumming with electronic triggering to create the band's mechanical but unmistakably human pulse.

name: Immortal Prophets
description: Immortal Prophets combine crushing nu-metal riffs, rap-rock rhythms, cinematic atmosphere, and philosophical lyrics about power, mortality, and human conflict.
biography: Immortal Prophets emerged from Pittsburgh's heavy music community with a sound that refuses to choose between aggression and atmosphere. Their songs move from whispered philosophical observations to massive drop-tuned riffs, incorporating rap, melody, screams, and cinematic production. QFR signed the band because their music gives the label a heavy act with genuine thematic depth rather than relying solely on aggression.

members.name: Cain Vesper
members.bio: Cain moves between restrained melodic vocals, rhythmic delivery, and explosive screams with an unusually theatrical presence.

members.name: Joss Halek
members.bio: Joss writes the band's central riffs and specializes in creating massive guitar arrangements around rhythmic vocal patterns.

members.name: Mira Solt
members.bio: Mira provides the band's low-end weight and an important second vocal presence.

members.name: Rook Danner
members.bio: Rook's aggressive rhythmic style gives the band its physical live impact.

name: Firewall Nation
description: Firewall Nation combine rap-rock cadence, nu-metal guitar weight, modern production, and emotionally charged lyrics about identity, information, loyalty, and what gets through.
biography: Firewall Nation grew from a collaboration between Philadelphia musicians who believed rap and heavy rock had become far too separated. Their music treats information overload, social pressure, technology, and personal identity as material for songs rather than political slogans. The band's live show is built around the contrast between precise rhythmic verses and explosive guitar-driven choruses. QFR signed Firewall Nation because the group embodies the label's belief that genre boundaries are tools, not rules.

members.name: Ace Calderon
members.bio: Ace brings rhythmic precision and sharp lyrical delivery to the band's verses.

members.name: Rye Patton
members.bio: Rye provides the band's melodic and aggressive vocal counterpoint.

members.name: Gio Hart
members.bio: Gio builds the band's heavy guitar foundation while leaving room for the rhythmic elements to breathe.

members.name: Zee Okonkwo
members.bio: Zee combines live bass, electronic production, and low-end programming to create the band's modern sound.

members.name: Pix Renner
members.bio: Pix blends live drumming with modern rhythmic techniques, giving the band's songs their distinctive bounce.

name: Justified Heroes
tagline: Songs for the ones who stayed.
description: Justified Heroes combine pop-punk urgency with the emotional honesty and street-level storytelling of the New Jersey rock tradition.
biography: Justified Heroes grew up between New Jersey shore towns, suburban garages, and the clubs connecting Philadelphia and New York. Their songs are built around friendships, missed opportunities, growing older, and the strange feeling of realizing the people you grew up with are changing alongside you. The band's sound combines melodic punk energy with the heartland storytelling tradition of their home state. QFR signed them because their songs feel immediate without being disposable.

members.name: Jack Morrow
members.bio: Jack writes emotionally direct songs about friendships, mistakes, and trying to grow up without losing yourself.

members.name: Ryan Doyle
members.bio: Ryan provides the band's melodic guitar work and layered vocal harmonies.

members.name: Matt Kelley
members.bio: Matt gives the band its driving low end and has a reputation for keeping rehearsals moving.

members.name: Eddie Vance
members.bio: Eddie brings the band's energetic live attack and knows exactly when a song needs to accelerate.

name: Cinder Block Statues
description: Cinder Block Statues are a genre-defying male-and-female duo combining phonk-inspired bass, distorted grooves, cinematic production, and contrasting lead vocals.
biography: Cinder Block Statues formed around a simple idea: take the low-end aggression and hypnotic rhythm of phonk and build an actual songwriting project around it. The result is a male-and-female vocal duo whose music shifts between smoky melodic passages, distorted bass grooves, electronic textures, and sudden bursts of rock energy. Based in Staten Island, the duo represents one of the most experimental corners of the QFR roster.

members.name: Roman Voss
members.bio: Roman provides the darker vocal counterpoint and produces the duo's bass-heavy foundation.

members.name: Nova Reign
members.bio: Nova is the melodic and visual center of Cinder Block Statues, bringing a powerful female lead vocal and guitar presence to the duo's unusual sound.

name: Easton Echo
tagline: Big feelings. Bright lights. No borrowed story.
description: Easton Echo is a modern male singer-songwriter blending emotionally detailed storytelling with polished synth-pop, alternative rock, and arena-sized melodies.
biography: Easton Echo is the newest artist to join Quantum Frequency Records and one of the most intriguing additions to the label's expanding universe. Born and raised in New Jersey, Easton began writing songs as a teenager, initially recording rough demos alone in his bedroom before developing a distinctive blend of synth-pop, alternative rock, and deeply personal songwriting. His music pairs intimate verses with enormous melodic choruses, creating songs that feel both conversational and cinematic. QFR was drawn to Easton not because he fit an existing category, but because he demonstrated the rare ability to make polished pop music while maintaining the feeling that someone is actually telling you something. His debut QFR release, 'The Way You Stay,' introduces an artist whose story is only beginning.

members.name: Easton Echo
members.role: Lead Vocals / Guitar / Piano / Songwriter / Producer
members.bio: Easton Echo writes emotionally detailed songs that turn ordinary moments into large-scale pop stories. He is the newest artist signed to Quantum Frequency Records.
